summary: Triage a 36-card sourcing backlog through the Todoist CLI. The agent must discover the project/sections, list cards with IDs, run todoist show for each card to read the hidden note, then move every original card to either Ready to PO or Re-source with the exact replacement label set. No report file is graded; the live Todoist mock state is the sole deliverable.
check_strategy: private/expected_answer.json drives deterministic checks; the verifier reads the live todoist_cli project state over MOCK_SITE_URL/__bench/state. Binary pass requires all checks. The task is meant to stress correct Todoist CLI operation: ID-based edits, section-name routing, replacement semantics of --label-names, preserving the active card set, and leaving Backlog empty.

checks.description: Todoist bench state is reachable and the sourcing project exists.
Each of the 36 original cards is active and in the correct target section: Ready to PO when covered, Re-source when not covered.
Each of the 36 original cards has exactly the expected label set: no labels for covered cards; capability-gap plus every applicable reason label for not-covered cards.
The project contains exactly the original 36 active cards, preventing create/delete/duplicate-card shortcuts.
No active card remains in Backlog (to triage).

notes: Total checks = 75: 1 mock reachability + 36 section checks + 36 exact-label checks + exact active-card-set + backlog-empty. Capability interpretation remains necessary to choose the state change, but the difficulty is centered on using Todoist CLI mechanics correctly, especially hidden notes and replacement-style label updates.
